item.title: The getaway truck; when Trump gets stuck in Iran’s quagmire
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) – US President Donald Trump departed on a secret military flight from Turkey to Britain last month when the White House said he was flying aboard ⁠Air Force One, in an extraordinary ruse – prompted by an assassination threat.

item.title: Iran’s southern coasts undergoing cleanup after oil pollution
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) – Iran’s Department of Environment has launched operations to clean up oil pollution along the southern coasts of Qeshm Island and Hengam Island following the environmental consequences of military aggression by the enemy.

item.title: Knowledge, human dignity in eyes of Islamic personality
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) – Knowledge, dialogue, human dignity, and justice in the eyes of a prominent Islamic personality is Imam Reza's (AS) message for contemporary world of today that must be taken into serious consideration.

item.title: 2 US army soldiers killed in Texas chopper crash
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) – Two US Army soldiers died when an Apache military helicopter ‌attached to the service's Fort Hood ‌base crashed into a field in Texas on Wednesday, sparking a large grass fire, officials said.

item.title: US environ. damage must be addressed in Hormuz arrangements
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) – Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson has warned the environmental damage caused by the US military presence and operations in the Persian Gulf must be addressed in any future arrangements governing the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: FM Araghchi slams France over "vivid" human rights hypocrisy
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) –Iranian foreign minister has lashed out at France for blatant hypocrisy over its claims to defend human rights and international law, pointing to its support for the Israeli regime’s actions in Gaza and aggression against Iran.

item.title: US menace against civilian sites breach of Geneva Convention
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 13 (MNA) – Condemning US threats and attacks against civilian infrastructures, the spokesman for the Iranian Foreign Ministry said US menace against civilian centers in Iran is clear violations of the Geneva Conventions and war crimes.

item.title: Iran, Pakistan must lead Islamic unity
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Mohsen Rezaei, chief of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, told Pakistan's visiting interior minister that the two countries were among the great powers of the Islamic world and had a duty to work toward Muslim unity.

item.title: Iran not acted outside international law: Pezeshkian
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – President Masoud Pezeshkian told Japan's prime minister on Wednesday that Iran had "in no way acted outside international law," blaming the United States and Israel for destabilising the region.

item.title: Pakistan working to bring US, Iran ‘to negotiating table’
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Pakistan's Foreign Ministry spokesman says that Islamabad is working to “bring the two parties to the negotiating table” and prevent efforts to undermine the peace process.

item.title: Arrest warrants against Israeli criminals cannot be erased
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – A senior Iranian diplomat says that the arrest warrants issued for Israeli officials accused of crimes in Gaza cannot simply be erased.

item.title: Tehran expresses sympathy over deadly earthquake in Colombia
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Iran has offered condolences to the people and government of Colombia following a powerful earthquake that killed hundreds of people and caused widespread destruction in the South American country.

item.title: Drone strike hits northern Iraq
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Regional media outlets reported drone attacks on Kurdistan region in northern Iraq.

item.title: IRGC ordered to build capability to strike enemy soil
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Iran's IRGC must be able to take the war into enemy lands, a senior commander said Wednesday, adding that the IRGC had been ordered to build the capability for offensive operations beyond the country's borders.

item.title: Iran to join BRICS development bank in near future
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Iran will soon join the BRICS New Development Bank, Central Bank Governor Abdolnasser Hemmati said on Wednesday, calling the bank the most important achievement of the bloc's cooperation.

item.title: Hormuz will reopen only when US accepts Iran’s conditions
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 12 (MNA) – Iran’s top security official says the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz will only happen when the United States accepts Iran’s conditions.

item.title: Seven dead in brawl aboard USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Reports show that a violent and bloody confrontation broke out among the crew of the U.S. aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln, after the carrier spent months in the region and took part in military operations against Iran.

item.title: US has no warship left in Persian Gulf region: IRGC spox
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) spokesperson said the United States has no even one signle warship in the Persian Gulf after the “Ramadan War” against Iran.

item.title: President Pezeshkian receives Pakistani delegation in Tehran
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – President Masoud Pezeshkian received for a meeting a Pakistani delegation headed by Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Tuesday in Tehran.

item.title: Pilgrims served in Mawkib en rout to Imam Reza holy shrine
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – There are Mawkibs (tents) on the roads to Mashhad to serve pilgrim who go on foot towards the holy Shrine of Imam Reza in the holy city located in northeast Iran.

item.title: Lebanese government’s direct talks with Israel ‘pointless’
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Vice President of Lebanon’s Supreme Islamic Shia Council (SISC), Sheikh Ali Khatib, has categorically dismissed direct talks between the Beirut government and the Israeli regime, stressing that the negotiations are pointless.

item.title: Araghchi receives Pakistani interior minister
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi received visiting Pakistan's Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Naqvi and his accompanying delegation for a meeting in Tehran on Tuesday.

item.title: Iran not to retreat from its rights in face of any threats
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Newly-appointed secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) has said that Iran will not to back down from its rights in the face any threats.

item.title: Iran, Malaysia defense chiefs emphasize expanding cooperation
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Iran’s Acting Defense Minister Brigadier General Seyyed Majid Ibn Reza and Malaysian Defense Minister Dato Seri Mohamed Khaled Nordin in a phone call on Tuesday stressed the need to strengthen and expand defense cooperation.

item.title: Pakistan says Iran, US close to sort of agreement over Hormuz
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Pakistani defense minister claims that Iran and the Unnited States are close to a sort of agreement over the Strait of Hormuz

item.title: VIDEO: Handala II sets sails towards Gaza
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Handala II sets sail as part of the latest Freedom Flotilla mission, with stops planned in Scandinavia, Western Europe, and the Mediterranean before heading toward Gaza.

item.title: Pakistani interior minister arrives in Tehran
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Pakistan's Interior Minister Syed Mohsin Naqvi has arrived in Tehran for talks with Iranian officials.

item.title: Pezeshkian calls for transparency in economic policymaking
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has urged greater transparency and justice in economic policymaking, stressing that people’s livelihoods must remain the government’s primary concern and policies should prioritize the poor.

item.title: UKMTO reports maritime incident involving vessel in Oman Gulf
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operation (UKMTO) announced a maritime incident involving a container ship and military forces in the Gulf of Oman on Tuesday.

item.title: Israel advances plan to build 650 housing units illegally
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 11 (MNA) – The Israeli regime has advanced plans to build around 650 housing units in a new illegal settlement south of Al-Quds on land adjacent to Palestinian homes, the Palestinian Al-Quds Governorate said Monday.
